content.user_title: Build a Verified Marketing Claims Registry
content.value_statement: Marketing claims and offers become inconsistent when evidence, dates, and approved wording are scattered. This skill maintains a canonical ledger with provenance, disclaimers, usage, and expiry details.
actual_capabilities: Extracts distinct marketing claims from pasted ads, pages, briefs, and drafts.
Records exact wording, evidence source, evidence date, provenance, disclaimers, usage, and review dates.
Deduplicates equivalent claims and stores approved wording variants under one ledger entry.
Maintains an offers table with terms, codes, dates, landing pages, status, and linked claims.
Expires stale evidence and ended offers while tracking unresolved claims and open loops.
Answers claim, offer, and usage lookups and produces a concise change summary.
limitations: It records evidence status but does not verify truth or approve claims for publication.
It depends on user-provided records, documents, terms, and dates.
It does not manage sponsorship labels, tracking specifications, ad copy, or landing-page changes.
It modifies declared project memory files and requests consent before the first project write.

use_cases.title: Maintain paid campaign claims
use_cases.description: Register claims and live offers before campaign builders reuse approved wording.

use_cases.title: Prepare substantiation reviews
use_cases.description: Locate evidence sources, disclaimers, usage locations, and expiry dates for each claim.

use_cases.title: Resolve content source flags
use_cases.description: Merge flagged claims from drafts into one ledger and identify missing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Register one claim
prompt_templates.prompt: Register this claim exactly: [claim]. Evidence: [source and date]. Record its provenance, disclaimers, usage, and review date.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add a single marketing claim with supporting information.

prompt_templates.title: Log current offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Log these offers: [terms, codes, start dates, end dates, and landing pages]. Mark each offer as upcoming, live, or ended.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create or update the live offers table.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve source flags
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these drafts and claim candidates: [content]. Register or merge each claim. List every claim that still has no evidence on file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Process unresolved source flags from campaign content.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile the complete registry
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconcile the claims ledger and offers table against these records: [records]. Deduplicate claims, expire stale entries, update usage, and summarize all changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced registry sweep across multiple sources.

output_examples.input: Register the claim 'Cuts reporting time by 40%' with Internal timing study, March 2026.
output: Registered the exact claim text with the named evidence source and date.
Added a six-month review date and recorded no disclaimer because none was provided.

output_examples.input: Log SAVE50 for 50% off annual plans from July 1 through July 31.
output: Added the offer with code SAVE50, dates, terms, and live status.
Flagged the landing page as missing because no URL was provided.
Linked discount claims should expire when the offer ends.

output_examples.input: Sweep the claim candidates and resolve every missing-source flag.
output: Merged duplicate wording into existing claim entries.
Registered unsupported claims as none-on-file without approving them.
Listed unresolved claims and expiring evidence in the open-loop summary.

best_practices: Provide exact claim text and name each evidence document with its date.
Review proposed changes before saving and keep canonical files under version control.
Use the designated audit or content review skill when a publication verdict is required.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a none-on-file entry as approved or substantiated.
Do not invent evidence, dates, disclaimers, or approved wording variants.
Do not use this registry to judge campaigns, write ad copy, or change landing pages.

faq.question: What information does the registry store?
faq.answer: It stores exact claims, evidence provenance, approved wording, disclaimers, usage, review dates, and linked offer details.

faq.question: Does this skill verify that a claim is true?
faq.answer: No. It records the evidence status and routes approval decisions to the appropriate review skill.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The claim is registered as none-on-file and included in unresolved items. The skill does not approve it.

faq.question: Can it work without external APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can work from pasted content, named documents, calendars, and user-provided exports.

faq.question: Which files does it update?
faq.answer: It updates the claims ledger, offers table, hot cache, open loops, and processed claim candidates within project memory.

faq.question: How are expired offers handled?
faq.answer: Ended offers become inactive, and dependent claims enter the expiry workflow for review.
